noncomputable def poleInput (ℓ η q t : ℚ) (D : Fin 6 → Fin 12 → K0) : ℚ :=
  slopeR ℓ (slopeA (slopeR0 η t) q) (slopeR0 η t) /
    traceTheta (fun g => groupW (slopeR ℓ (slopeA (slopeR0 η t) q) (slopeR0 η t))
      (normTests (slopeR0 η t) t (D g))) ^ 2
